body:
Pushed all three deltas and verified full test suite (test_cargo_wrapper.sh + test_tmp_sweep.sh ALL PASS, clean git status):
- PR #9 (product/story-79 @ 73130dd): (1) Test 24b uses 'test --no-run --exclude pkg_a' then 'test --no-run --exclude pkg_b'; (2) EPOCHREALTIME/t_start comma-normalized and mid-run edit tested under comma locale; (3) realpath only called when mt > stamp_ns (memoized per dir).
- PR #10 (product/story-80 @ eba56db, rebased on 73130dd): fixed tests/test_cargo_wrapper.sh:1497 err_brefuse line ('bash "$W" build b_stderr_refuse 2>&1 >/dev/null {b80_0}>&- {b80_1}>&-').
- PR #11 (product/bug-83 @ 88f21a9, rebased on eba56db): .aida/config.toml cargo-reap-report prompt is strictly report-only ('Run cargo reap (dry-run) and cargo ps; report the would-reap list and free space to the operator. Never pass --apply.') and bin/cargo-reap uses 'rm -rf --one-file-system'.
Ready for direct delta verification!
subject: REWORK READY: aida-host PRs #9 (73130dd), #10 (eba56db), #11 (88f21a9)
